reasons.title-embeds: A new title re-embeds (the kind registry's `indexed`, title: 'embed'): the vector is rebuilt from the title and the summary the item keeps, one embedding on the local embedder and no model call (the extractor's embed_only step; a table reuses its summary in the model step and rebuilds its profile passages locally; a name-only file re-runs its spine, no model either). On main a rename re-indexed nothing, so vector search and recall kept the old title.
reasons.unchanged-no-reindex: A save that sends a field back unchanged re-indexes nothing: fields are compared by value (changedFields), as tasks, notes, journals and contacts already did. On main the field's presence in the save cleared the summary and queued a model pass, one per save.
reasons.reindex-flag-gone: The page PATCH `reindex: false` flag is accepted and ignored: a doc written through PATCH is indexed like a commit (one model pass, as the same write without the flag). On main it left the index on the previous doc and pointed at a POST .../reindex route that never existed; no client sends it (the editor saves drafts and commits).
reasons.indexing-flip-resets: A file whose indexing mode flips has its summary and vector dropped at once (field `indexing`: 'extract'), not only its completion marker: a file turned name-only stops answering from its content now, not when the re-run lands. The same work is queued as on main: one extractor pass (the name-only direction needs no model, the full direction runs it).
